WITH date_info AS ( SELECT a.account_seq, a.status, a.dropout_date, c.cur_seq, c.cur_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, CASE WHEN a.status IN ('DROPOUT', 'EARLYOUT') AND a.dropout_date IS NOT NULL THEN LEAST(a.dropout_date, c.end_date) ELSE LEAST(CURRENT_DATE, c.end_date) END as reference_date FROM lms.tb_account a JOIN lms.tb_curriculum c ON a.cur_seq = c.cur_seq WHERE a.account_seq = #{accountSeq} AND a.del_yn = 'N' ), -- 1. 일자별 캘린더 생성 및 정확한 회차(unit_month) 부여 calendar_daily AS ( SELECT di.account_seq, d.day::date as work_date, (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(d.day::date, di.start_date)) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(d.day::date, di.start_date)))::int + 1 as unit_month FROM date_info di CROSS JOIN generate_series(di.start_date, di.reference_date, '1 day'::interval) as d(day) WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM d.day) NOT IN (0, 6) -- 주말 제외 ), -- 2. 회차별(월별) 통계 계산 monthly_stats AS ( SELECT cd.unit_month, MIN(cd.work_date) as month_start, MAX(cd.work_date) as month_end, COUNT(cd.work_date) as month_working_days, COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 END) as month_absent, COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status IN ('LATE', 'OUTING', 'EARLY') THEN 1 END) as month_etc FROM calendar_daily cd LEFT JOIN lms.tb_attendance att ON cd.account_seq = att.account_seq AND cd.work_date = att.attendance_date GROUP BY cd.unit_month ) -- 3. 최종 결과 집계 SELECT di.account_seq, a.account_name, a.status as accountStatus, di.cur_name, TO_CHAR(di.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as startDate, TO_CHAR(di.end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as endDate, TO_CHAR(di.reference_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as referenceDate, (SELECT SUM(month_working_days) FROM monthly_stats)::int as totalWorkingDays,
COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 END)::int as absentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status = 'LATE' THEN 1 END)::int as lateCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status = 'OUTING' THEN 1 END)::int as outingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status = 'EARLY' THEN 1 END)::int as earlyCount,
( SELECT json_agg(t) FROM ( SELECT unit_month as unitMonth, TO_CHAR(month_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as mStart, TO_CHAR(month_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as mEnd, month_working_days as mWorkingDays, ROUND((1 - (month_absent + (month_etc / 3)::numeric) / NULLIF(month_working_days, 0)) * 100, 2) as mRate FROM monthly_stats ORDER BY unitMonth ) t ) as monthlyData
FROM date_info di JOIN lms.tb_account a ON di.account_seq = a.account_seq LEFT JOIN lms.tb_attendance att ON di.account_seq = att.account_seq AND att.attendance_date BETWEEN di.start_date AND di.reference_date WHERE a.del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY di.account_seq, a.account_name, a.status, di.cur_name, di.start_date, di.end_date, di.reference_date

mapper.select: SELECT A.account_seq, A.account_name, A.main_image_path, B.attendance_seq, B.cur_seq, COALESCE(B.attendance_date, CAST(#{attendanceDate} AS DATE)) as attendance_date, B.status, TO_CHAR(B.start_time, 'HH24:MI') as start_time, TO_CHAR(B.end_time, 'HH24:MI') as end_time, B.remark, B.main_file_path FROM lms.tb_account A LEFT OUTER JOIN lms.tb_attendance B ON (A.account_seq = B.account_seq AND B.cur_seq = #{curSeq} AND B.attendance_date = CAST(#{attendanceDate} AS DATE)) WHERE A.cur_seq = #{curSeq} A.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY A.account_name ASC
